maria: Quick heads-up 00:00am PT publish target for the release post. Need final changelog URL + docs anchors + canary timing from eng.
ben: API freeze Tue EOD PT. Changelog draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/2.1 — I'll push final note after QA.
liam: Docs PR incoming, will add anchors #new-routing #kv-cache #quant-profiles and post the live page URL when merged.
ash: Staging deploy scheduled Tue 11:00am PT; will mirror prod doc paths and drop preview links here.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2025-11-05T16:00:00Z initial 10% on Dedicated; automatic fallback to Hosted if errors >2%.
sara: Marketing needs the benchmark headline for hero. Product sign-off: "~50% lower per-token cost at 8k seq with smart batching". Ben confirm?
ben: Confirmed on canary snapshot. p95 120ms -> 85ms, throughput +30% in dedicated pool. I'll add measurement caveats to the changelog.
ania: I'll produce hero SVG (1200x630) + thumbnail PNG (600x315) by EOD. Color: #0a6cff; caption: "measurements on Redwood Dedicated (nvlink enabled)".
maria: Great — once docs URL and changelog link are final I'll schedule the CMS publish and tag legal for embargo. Reply ASAP if anything blocks.
